notes.title: Hmm. Hypersense Level Editor next update?
notes.notes:
Gimme your ideas lads.

oh yeah in the next update you WILL be able to Create,Share and Play other people's LEVELS!

currently i dont have it IN GAME cuz umm I NEED FUNDING-

yeah umm just to speed up the process i used a few HELPFUL UE Marketplace assets (or plugins)
to make the Achievement System but the movement is all by me. same as the timer, UI and cutscenes.

(and the lil drawing which ofc i did do that and dont forget the half of the music is made by me and the other was on the marketplace since i kinda got interested in it. idk why but i loved it.)

My Main plan is to set the game to the workshop page (i mean i have steamcore finally which is a plugin that's worth the same price as the publishing fee)

add a BUNCH of assets that i have that include in game but other more.. beautiful looking ones.

yknow like trees or seperate walls.

mainly for the first update on this level editor that will roll out soon i'll put the main assets used in the game currently and including more lazer variations or perhaps more ways to diversify the map that you want to do.

i'll slowly but surely making this a game you guys want to get and play your friend's new level or make funny levels with goofy music (i better not be responsible for that shit istfg)

but mainly i want this game to be big. it has the potential to live up to it's speedrunning style i've cemented in the game now with the occuring update helping you move freely in the air and on ground with quick and responsive movement.

additionally i put a speedrun mode which if you complete all of the levels (levels through 1-9) under 40 seconds you WILL be able to achieve the HYPERSENSE MASTER achievement!

it's hard trust me.

i tried it.

didnt even do faster than 40 seconds.

im garbage at my own game-

notes.title: here we are. a new update will come out soon.
notes.notes:
so to keep things short after a couple months later i released the game entirely but something lacked besides the level design.

updates and mainly updating the movement.

the next update will have a new level and an updated MOVEMENT!

well mainly making the movement more responsive rather than gliding like crazy.

besides that a new level will be more.. enclosed and with some puzzles.

you can comment what you guys want in the game as an additional mode+ leaderboards are on their way!
yes you heard me.

leaderboards. lead your way as the number one runner as you crush your friend's time in the next update!

cant wait to see this game pop off again (like it'll surpass the launch day lmao)

anyways stay tuned to see EXCLUSIVE SCREENSHOTS oh and it's on UE5 now

notes.title: Final Early Access Version?
notes.notes:
Heya.
Game's Progress is close to release so i'll drop another update in the next few weeks and then the full version will be out and ready for more reviews to be seen.

early access is for any bugs,issues or feedback to be sent to me and further improve the game.
so please if you have any issues be sure to leave a comment or a review on what you think so far!

v1.2 will have more levels but another movement update which it feels more tight i'd say.
also there will be a few effects added so that's cool to have that as an addition!

cya imma go work on it rn.
